history.locked: Saved with each change by the database itself. Entries cannot be edited, only you can see them, and the last 30 days can never be removed.

keep.title: How long to keep the history
keep.intro: Older entries are removed automatically each time you open the Admin app. Whatever you choose, the last 30 days always stay, and a note of every cleanup stays in the history.
keep.olderNow: {{count}} entries are older than {{period}} right now.
keep.failed: Could not save or clean up. Try again.

trash.title: Recently deleted
trash.intro: Everything deleted in the dashboards, kept for {{days}} days. Restore puts it back exactly as it was — same links and QR codes.
trash.loadFailed: Could not load the recycle bin. Check the Firestore rules are deployed.
trash.empty: Nothing has been deleted. Deleted items will wait here.
trash.restoreText: Everything below goes back exactly where it was, with the same links and codes. The restore is written to the history.
trash.purgeText: It is removed now instead of in 30 days. This cannot be undone.
trash.conflictTitle: Something new is in its place

conflict.taken: another link now uses this path

trash.nothingLeft: This entry holds nothing to restore.
trash.failed: That did not work. Check your connection and try again.
trash.footnote: Only you see this page. Entries are removed for good {{days}} days after the delete, the next time you open the Admin app.

backup.title: Backup
backup.intro: One file with every record in the dashboards — certificates, forms and their answers, news with photos, supervision, short links, admins and history. The free plan keeps no backups of its own, so download one about once a month.
backup.first: No backup has been made yet. Download the first one now.
backup.overdue: The last backup is over a month old — time for a new one.
backup.done: Saved {{count}} records ({{size}}). Check your downloads folder.
backup.failed: The backup could not be made. Check your connection and try again.
backup.keepSafe: Keep the file somewhere private, such as your own Google Drive. It holds everything, including participants' names, answers and signatures — share it with no one.
backup.storageNote: An estimate, added up from the records and refreshed once a day (once a week above 100 MB). Firebase also keeps search indexes, so its own figure can be a little higher.
backup.storageFull: Storage is {{percent}}% full. Download a backup, then clear out old photos or responses.
backup.storageFailed: The storage could not be counted. Check your connection and try again.
backup.restoreIntro: Choose a backup file. Nothing changes until you confirm: first you see what is different from the database now.
backup.restoreBadFile: This is not a backup file from this site.
backup.restoreNothing: The database already matches this backup.
backup.restoreAdminsHint: Off at first: a removed admin would get access back.
backup.restoreReplace: Also replace records that changed since the backup
backup.restoreReplaceHint: Their current version is lost, so download a fresh backup first. Off: only missing records come back.
backup.restoreNever: Nothing is ever deleted, and the history and recycle bin stay as they are.
backup.restoreConfirmAdd: {{missing}} missing records come back as they were in the backup. Nothing else changes.
backup.restoreConfirmReplace: {{missing}} missing records come back, and {{changed}} current records are replaced with the backup's version. This cannot be undone without a fresh backup.
backup.restorePartial: Restored {{count}} records. {{failed}} could not be restored:
backup.restoreFailed: The restore could not start. Check your connection and try again.
backup.introBelajar: One file with every record of the learning platform: surahs, sections and questions. Keep it somewhere private, such as your own Google Drive.
